verified.blob_revocation: Deterministic tested URL ownership; browser DOM confirms detachment, not a browser-internal URL registry inspection.
verified.settled_seek_evidence: Actual DRAFT output (production paint requires both !seeking and exact local offsets), readyState 4, visible/error-free videos, matching currentSrc and unique actual native-window/currentTime correspondence.
verified.closed_unloaded_evidence: The actual src attribute is empty, root/videos are hidden, readyState is 0, decoded dimensions are 0x0, duration is null and currentTime is 0. Any sticky currentSrc must match a previously observed loaded owned Blob URL.

native_lifecycle.compound_cache: Exact baseline+1/+2/+3 expected only for the known Timeline1 compound after native Apply/Undo/Redo; all other media fields exact.
native_lifecycle.dirty: Native Undo increments history.generation, so restored parameters remain dirty until Save.
native_lifecycle.autosave: An existing pending recovery record is retained exactly; otherwise each dirty generation produces an independently checked ready recovery record.

limitations: The real 601-second 16x16 silent source proves long absolute addressing and separated bounded windows, not uninterrupted long-duration playback or audio continuity.
Continuous pointer movement outside uncached proxy windows is not qualified by this numeric recenter check.
High-resolution decode, hardware GPU operation, physical audio and cross-machine physical DPI behavior are not qualified.
The existing Windows browser and environment were reused; no browser or driver installation. The main editor retains five unsaved MoveClips.

Public manifests contain frame_map_evidence rather than the dense API frames field. Full raw private input files and their SHA-256 values are retained; all assertions run against the full arrays before compaction.

The read-only Windows bridge does not directly expose video.seeking; null observations are retained as null. Settled state is supported by the observed production DRAFT status and exact native-window/time checks, without fabricating a false flag.

After detach/load the Windows bridge may retain a prior owned Blob string in currentSrc. The evidence retains that value; it does not claim currentSrc became blank. Native unloaded DOM fields, empty src and deterministic URL release tests establish reset/detach behavior without inspecting a browser-internal URL registry.
